title: The One-More-Story Loop | Parenting Rewind
audience_intent: Adults and parents; not directed to children
education_scope: General parenting education only; not personalised therapy, diagnosis, or medical advice.

narration.transcript: One more story sounds small, but five extra stories can turn connection into a nightly negotiation. Announcing the limit only after reading makes the ending feel unexpected to a tired child. Rewind to before the first page and make the plan visible and simple. Say: Tonight you may choose one long book or two short books; after our choice, the books rest until tomorrow. Choices work when both options fit your limit; enjoy the reading fully, then close the routine as promised.

source.title: Toddler Bedtime Trouble: 7 Tips for Parents
